content: where INLINEFORM0 and INLINEFORM1 are parameters to control the importance of each component in the model. Component INLINEFORM2 will be used to constrain the representation of the locations based on their textual description (i.e. Flickr tags), INLINEFORM3 will be used to constrain the representation of the locations based on their numerical features, and INLINEFORM4 will impose the constraint that locations belonging to the same category should be close together in the space. We will discuss each of these components in more detail in the following sections.
